                    fire("poke");
                    onPoke?.("head");

                  onPointerMove={(e) => {
                    if (e.buttons === 0 && e.pointerType !== "touch") return;
                    S.petAmount += 0.12;
                    if (S.petAmount > 2.2 && S.petCooldown <= 0) {
                      S.petAmount = 0;
                      S.petCooldown = 2.5;
                      fire("pet");
                    }
                  }}
                >
